original_datasets.notes: Data appear to cover Illinois plumbing firms. Key analysis variables: complaints_2008 (count outcome) and first_A (indicator). Some variables have substantial missingness due to subsample collection (e.g., fixedfee/hourlyrate/emergency).

tasks.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without additional restriction.

analysis_path.path_description: Test whether firms with names starting with A have more complaints using t-test/chi-squared, then logistic, Poisson, zero-inflated Poisson, and negative binomial regressions; compute marginal effects at means.
analysis_path.model_family: t_test, chi2, logistic_regression, poisson, zero_inflated_poisson, negative_binomial
preprocessing_steps: Fit bivariate t-test and chi-squared tests by first_A.
Fit logistic regressions for binary outcome.
Fit Poisson count models and assess overdispersion.
Fit zero-inflated Poisson models (inflate: first_A and controls).
Compute marginal effects at means for selected models.

key_choices.outcome_measure: complaints_2008 (count of complaints in 2008); alternative binary complaints_2008_bin.
key_choices.main_predictor_measure: first_A (indicator that firm name starts with letter A).
key_choices.data_processing: Construct binary outcome for logistic and chi-squared analyses; compute marginal effects at means.
key_choices.model_choice: Multiple models: t-test, chi-squared, logistic, Poisson, zero-inflated Poisson, negative binomial.
key_choices.inference_rule: z- or t-statistics and p-values for first_A coefficient; overdispersion check for Poisson.

tasks.task_instruction: Use only the data of Illinois Plumbing Firms; do not restrict to metro Chicago; exclude external review sources; use overall complaints; produce a single main statistical test.

analysis_path.path_description: Run t-test by first_A and fit a negative binomial regression of complaints_2008 on first_A only; report z-statistic/p-value for first_A.
preprocessing_steps: Compute two-sample t-test for complaints_2008 by first_A.
Fit negative binomial regression: complaints_2008 ~ first_A.
Report z-statistic and p-value for first_A.
